# LockMic

> Free, open-source macOS menu bar app for system-wide microphone mute.

## Summary

LockMic mutes the microphone at the **system level** using Apple Core Audio (not app-specific mute buttons). It works in Zoom, Microsoft Teams, Google Meet, FaceTime, browsers, and every other app on the Mac. Control is from the menu bar, global hotkeys, and an optional on-screen / floating HUD. From 1.4 it can also **record locally**: default microphone plus system playback mixed to a dated AAC file on the Mac. Recordings are not uploaded.

- **Website:** https://lockmic.com/
- **GitHub:** https://github.com/oochernyshev/lockmic
- **License:** MIT
- **Publisher:** WIXEE.AI (https://wixee.ai)
- **Partnerships / press:** info@wixee.ai
- **Price:** Free
- **Platform:** macOS 14 Sonoma or later
- **Current version:** 1.4.4

## Key facts

- Mutes hardware / system input devices via Core Audio
- Default: mute all controllable input devices (optional: default input only)
- Virtual Core Audio devices are listed but ignored for mute control
- Global hotkeys: toggle (⌘⇧M, optional ⌘F5), mute/unmute, push-to-talk, push-to-mute, push-to-flip
- HUD toast and optional always-on floating HUD per display
- Optional local recording (mic + system playback → dated mix on disk; not uploaded)
- 23 UI languages following system language
- Install: DMG or Homebrew cask (custom tap)
- Not Developer ID notarized yet; users may need `xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/LockMic.app` after download

## Install

### DMG

https://github.com/oochernyshev/lockmic/releases/download/v1.4.4/LockMic-1.4.4.dmg

### Homebrew

```bash
brew tap oochernyshev/lockmic https://github.com/oochernyshev/lockmic
brew trust --cask oochernyshev/lockmic/lockmic
brew install --cask lockmic
xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/LockMic.app
open /Applications/LockMic.app
```

Homebrew 6+ requires trusting third-party casks once; `brew trust --cask` only trusts LockMic.

## Update

### Homebrew

```bash
brew update
brew upgrade --cask --yes lockmic
xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/LockMic.app
open /Applications/LockMic.app
```

### DMG

1. Download the latest DMG from https://lockmic.com/#download or GitHub Releases
2. Drag LockMic to Applications and choose Replace
3. Open LockMic from Applications
4. If macOS blocks it: `xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/LockMic.app`

## Difference vs in-app mute

App mute (e.g. Zoom) only silences that application. LockMic mutes the input device so **all** apps see a muted microphone.

## Privacy

If the user agrees to anonymous usage in the app: app version and action events only. No microphone audio, no recordings, no personal content. Features stay disabled until agreement. Recordings created in the app stay in a folder on the Mac (default `~/Movies/LockMic`) and are not sent to LockMic or WIXEE.AI.

The marketing website (lockmic.com) uses the same Google Analytics 4 property (`G-0ZRQC93T49`) for anonymous page views and download clicks.
